body.x: From January 5-8, Smart Geotech Co., Ltd. will showcase its visionary slope monitoring solution at CES 2023 in Las Vegas. The company's IoT-based Smart Early Warning System for Predicting Slope Failure blends innovative technology to deliver a cost-effective real-time slope monitoring solution that can avert tragedies and save lives.

The company envisions the demand growing for new developments and housing projects on hillsides along with population hikes. It points out that construction projects to accommodate new people encounter an increased risk of landslides due to unsafe slopes. To mitigate this danger, Smart Geotech developed the IoT-based Smart Early Warning System for Predicting Slope Failure that can provide real-time slope monitoring and warning alerts before a landslide happens.

Smart Geotech assures that SWS System aims to change how slope collapses are measured and predicted. With its innovative combination of an IoT sensor node and an LTE network, the system can send real-time measures of slopes to a centralized server. Then the server analyzes the data to warn responsible authorities of any changes or disruptions simultaneously. Managers can access status updates from anywhere without hassle or added cost. Smart Geotech predicts the SWS System could be an advanced, cost-efficient, life-saving technology - distinguishing from the competitors' detection process.

The high-precision technology can detect microdisplacements of the ground surface up to 0.01mm - compared to the 5mm of general competitors' - providing precise, reliable, and consistent results. Smart Geotech affirmed this easy-to-install tech assists construction and maintenance, through which supervisors have rapid and accurate notices of potential changes in slope conditions.

The SWS System, with IoT and local data analysis, won a CES 2023 Innovation Awards honoree in the Smart Cities product category. Attendees of CES 2023 can visit the Smart Geotech booth to learn more about this system with the company's other industry 4.0 standard ICT products and solutions. Its Booth #10824 is at the Tech East area in the North Hall of the Las Vegas Convention Center, the joint pavilion of the Korea Semiconductor Industry Association (KSIA).
